# NeoCRM

> NeoCRM is an open experiment in agent-native customer relationship management by Rob Tyrie, Ironstone Advisory. People and governed specialist agents manage unified relationships across sales, service and marketing, with provenance, consent and policy built in. NeoCRM owns the semantic model, not the storage model.

Status: specification-led. The runnable slice is CAP-001 (relationship brief) plus a read-only EXP-001 reference path; external writes are disabled. Code is MIT licensed; documentation is CC BY 4.0. Contact: rob+neocrm@ironstoneadvisory.com.
